items.title: The Corporate Name Game Could Cost You
items.summary: Would a rose by any other name be as profitable?  Research by quantitative analyst Alexander Hübbert shows that companies with a name change not related to a deal underperformed similar ones by more than 5 percentage points on average in the following year.  Altria  formerly Philip Morris, is a happy example.
